seo.title: Seedance 2.5 Coming Soon: What’s New | MaxVideoAI
seo.description: Discover the capabilities announced for Seedance 2.5, from 4K output and longer videos to multimodal guidance and precise editing.

overview: Seedance 2.5 is shaping up as a major evolution of Seedance, with more detail, longer formats and richer creative control.

hero.title: Seedance 2.5 is coming soon
hero.intro: Dreamina presents Seedance 2.5 by highlighting advances in resolution, duration, multimodal inputs, video references and precise local editing.

faqs.a: Seedance 2.5 brings together six announced advances: 4K output, videos up to 30 seconds, a beta mode up to 180 seconds, up to 50 multimodal inputs, reference-to-video control and precise local editing.

faqs.q: What video lengths have been announced?
faqs.a: The presentation highlights a standard mode up to 30 seconds and a beta long-video mode up to 180 seconds.

faqs.q: How does Seedance 2.5 expand creative control?
faqs.a: Announced multimodal inputs, video references and local editing are intended to give creators more material for guiding and refining each scene.
Try Seedance 2.0 or browse real Seedance examples to discover the model family’s visual possibilities.

announcedCapabilities.title: 4K output
announcedCapabilities.body: 4K output is among the announced highlights, opening the way to more detailed, polished imagery.

announcedCapabilities.title: Up to 30 seconds
announcedCapabilities.body: The announced standard mode reaches up to 30 seconds, leaving more room for complete scenes and ideas.

announcedCapabilities.title: Long-video beta
announcedCapabilities.body: A beta long-video mode up to 180 seconds is also presented for longer-form storytelling.

announcedCapabilities.title: Up to 50 inputs
announcedCapabilities.body: Up to 50 multimodal inputs are highlighted, allowing richer combinations of creative materials.

announcedCapabilities.title: Reference-to-video
announcedCapabilities.body: Video-reference control is presented as a way to guide generation from existing footage.

announcedCapabilities.title: Local video editing
announcedCapabilities.body: Precise local editing is presented as a way to refine selected parts of a video with greater control.
